quick_skim.title: IntriAdapt: Generalizable Intrinsic-Guided Test-Time Adaptation for Metric Geometry Estimation
quick_skim.abstract: Recovering metric 3D geometry from images is fundamentally ill-posed due to perspective projection ambiguity. Current geometry models incorporate supplied or predicted intrinsics during inference, but do not use them to supervise model adaptation. To refine these predictions, test-time adaptation (TTA) typically relies on external depth measurements. In this paper, we instead use camera intrinsics as an output-side geometric verifier. Comparing the point cloud's viewing rays with those defined by the known intrinsics yields a direct measure of geometric inconsistency. We propose \textit{IntriAdapt}, a TTA framework that minimizes this closed-form geometric residual. By optimizing a lightweight LoRA adapter on a frozen geometry foundation model, our method aligns the prediction with the specific camera model without depth sensors or external priors. We further extend this approach to video sequences, demonstrating that adapting a short sequence generalizes to other sequences captured by the same camera. The adapted model processes held-out images in a feed-forward pass, without repeating optimization for each frame. Experiments on ten single-image and seven sequence benchmarks across multiple base models show that \textit{IntriAdapt} consistently outperforms both unadapted and oracle-intrinsics baselines in metric accuracy and relative geometry.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: IntriAdapt tackles metric 3D geometry estimation by using camera intrinsics as an output-side geometric verifier and optimizing a lightweight LoRA adapter on a frozen geometry foundation model, refining predictions without external depth measurements.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对从图像恢复度量三维几何的病态性以及现有几何模型仅使用内参推理、未用其监督适应的问题，本文提出IntriAdapt测试时适应框架，把相机内参作为输出端几何验证器，通过最小化闭式几何残差优化冻结几何基础模型上的轻量LoRA适配器。方法无需外部深度测量即可在测试时精炼度量几何预测，实验显示其能提升跨场景泛化能力，为度量深度估计与几何基础模型的自适应提供了新思路。

quick_skim.title: Visual Memory and Textual Alignment for Cross-Modal Few-Shot Segmentation
quick_skim.abstract: Few-shot segmentation (FSS) aims to segment target objects with limited annotated examples. Recent studies have begun to explore large foundation models to improve generalization for this task. In particular, SAM 3 provides strong visual representations and supports text-guided segmentation. However, its performance remains limited in specialized domains, where semantic prompts and visual representations are often poorly aligned. To address this challenge, we propose ViTA-SAM, a framework built upon SAM 3 that integrates visual memory and textual features through cross-modal alignment. Specifically, we construct a visual memory module that encodes support features together with their corresponding masks, providing support-aware visual guidance for query prediction. In parallel, we leverage the text encoder of SAM 3 to extract semantic features as complementary priors. To bridge the gap between semantic and visual representations, we introduce a cross-modal alignment module that conditions textual features on memory-enhanced visual representations, yielding more consistent and visually grounded predictions. In addition, we propose a pseudo-label refinement strategy that updates the memory with predicted query masks, enabling query-adaptive representation learning. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that ViTA-SAM achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods, outperforming the strongest competing method by over 5% in average mIoU.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: ViTA-SAM builds on SAM 3 with a visual memory module and cross-modal text alignment to improve few-shot segmentation in specialized domains where semantic prompts and visual features are poorly aligned.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对少样本分割在专业领域中语义提示与视觉表征对齐不佳的问题，本文提出基于SAM 3的ViTA-SAM框架。该方法构建视觉记忆模块，将支撑特征与对应掩码一起编码，并通过跨模态对齐融合文本特征，为查询图像提供支撑感知的视觉引导。实验表明该框架在有限标注条件下提升了对目标物体的分割与泛化能力，为开放词汇与文本引导分割提供了可复用的思路。
